sections.subhead: Patient-First Healthcare Websites Built for Trust, Compliance & Online Appointments

body.text: Teknoppy designs hospital websites in Kerala that work as a digital front desk — online appointment booking by department and doctor, verified doctor profiles, clear department pages, and secure handling of patient data under India's DPDP Act. Most sites launch in 4-6 weeks.

Every hospital website design Kerala project is engineered around patient trust and rapid clinical access. Whether you run a multi-speciality hospital in Kochi, a NABH-accredited facility in Calicut, or a specialized healthcare centre in Trivandrum, we build digital platforms that reassure patients, streamline OP desk bookings, and display doctor credentials clearly.

sections.h2: Healthcare Website Challenges Hospital Administrators Face — and How We Solve Them
sections.intro: Kerala hospitals and diagnostic centres regularly face four critical bottlenecks on their websites:

items.title: Patients can't book an appointment without calling.
items.text: A phone-only OP enquiry process results in abandoned appointments and overburdened reception staff. We integrate direct online appointment booking connected to department and consultant schedules as a core platform feature.

items.title: Doctor credentials and specialties are buried.
items.text: Patients select hospitals based on clinical expertise. We build dedicated doctor profile pages displaying TCMC/NMC registrations, super-specialties, consulting OP hours, and direct booking links.

items.title: Department and clinical service information is scattered across PDFs.
items.text: Cardiology, orthopedics, oncology, pediatrics, and diagnostic wings each need dedicated, crawlable pages detailing procedures, facilities, and visiting specialists.

items.title: Patient data handling and compliance are treated as afterthoughts.
items.text: Healthcare sites handle sensitive patient information. Teknoppy builds with strict adherence to India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, ensuring encrypted communications, explicit consent capture, and role-based access.

sections.h2: Essential Modules for a Modern Hospital Website

items.html: Department & Doctor Appointment Booking: Seamless multi-department scheduling allowing patients to choose their doctor, date, and OP slot with instant SMS or WhatsApp confirmation. Explore our dedicated Booking System Development.
Verified Doctor Directory & Profiles: Structured pages highlighting medical qualifications, fellowships, consultation hours, and TCMC registration numbers for every consultant.
Specialty & Clinical Department Pages: Individual pages for each medical department outlining key conditions treated, advanced ICU/OT equipment, and affiliated specialists.
Secure Patient Portal & Lab Report Access: Secure login where patients can download test reports, prescriptions, and visit summaries. See our Customer Portal Development.
Emergency, Ambulance & Insurance Desk Details: One-tap 24/7 casualty calling, casualty routing, insurance TPA cashless claim lists, and hospital location maps visible sitewide.

outro.html: For single-practitioner clinics and dental practices, visit our dedicated Clinic Website Design Kerala page. For content management, see CMS Website Development.

items.title: NABH & NABL Accreditation Highlights
items.text: Prominent display of NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals) and NABL certifications, building immediate clinical trust for domestic and international patients.

items.title: DPDP Act 2023 Data Protection
items.text: End-to-end encrypted form submissions, compliant consent checkboxes, and secure hosting ensuring full alignment with Indian data privacy statutes.

items.title: NMC Medical Advertising Ethics
items.text: Ethical medical copywriting adhering to National Medical Commission guidelines — no misleading surgical claims or unverifiable medical promises.

items.title: Insurance & Cashless TPA Desks
items.text: Comprehensive directories of impaneled health insurance providers, government schemes (such as Karunya and Medisep), and cashless claim desks.

paragraphs.html: Greens Ayurveda — Azhiyur, Calicut: Teknoppy designed and developed a high-performing international patient portal and appointment booking system for Greens Ayurveda. The responsive, multilingual web platform resulted in a +240% increase in international booking enquiries from the GCC and Europe, with automated consultation scheduling and treatment package coordination.
Explore more case studies and client transformations on our Case Studies and Portfolio pages.

sections.h2: Hospital Website Design Pricing & Timelines in Kerala

paragraphs.text: Hospital website investment depends on the number of departments, doctor profiles, and whether appointment booking or patient portals are integrated:

paragraphs.html: Single-Specialty / Community Hospital: ₹45,000 – ₹90,000 (Delivery in 4–6 weeks). Includes up to 10 clinical pages, doctor directory, appointment enquiry forms, emergency desk highlights, and local SEO setup.

Multi-Specialty Hospital: ₹90,000 – ₹1,80,000 (Delivery in 6–8 weeks). Features comprehensive department architecture, online doctor appointment booking, insurance/TPA listings, NABH compliance badges, and bilingual support (Malayalam & English).

Hospital with Patient Portal & HMIS Sync: ₹1,80,000 – ₹3,50,000+ (Delivery in 8–10 weeks). Incorporates secure patient authentication, online lab report downloads, HMIS/EHR API integration, and telemedicine booking.
Need an exact estimate for your hospital or healthcare trust? Request a detailed proposal via our Request a Quote form or use our Website Cost Calculator.

sections.h2: Other Industries We Design Websites For
Frequently Asked Questions — Hospital Website Design Kerala

items.q: How much does hospital website design cost in Kerala?
items.a: Hospital website design in Kerala typically costs ₹45,000 to ₹90,000 for single-specialty hospitals (4–6 weeks), ₹90,000 to ₹1,80,000 for multi-specialty facilities with department booking (6–8 weeks), and ₹1,80,000 to ₹3,50,000+ for large hospitals requiring patient portals and HMIS integration (8–10 weeks).

items.q: Can patients book appointments online by doctor and department?
items.a: Yes. Our hospital websites feature intuitive appointment booking systems allowing patients to select clinical departments, view consultant availability, choose time slots, and receive instant confirmation via SMS and WhatsApp.

items.q: Can the website integrate with our existing HMIS or EHR software?
items.a: Yes. We build secure REST API integrations with existing Hospital Management Information Systems (HMIS) or Electronic Health Record (EHR) software to sync doctor schedules, patient registration numbers, and digital lab reports.

items.q: Can the hospital website be bilingual in Malayalam and English?
items.a: Yes. We frequently develop bilingual hospital websites with English and Malayalam language toggle options, ensuring accessibility for both local Kerala residents and international medical tourists.

items.q: How does Teknoppy ensure patient data security under the DPDP Act 2023?
items.a: Every hospital website build features SSL/TLS encryption, granular role-based administrative access, explicit patient consent mechanisms on medical forms, and secure data storage compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023.

items.q: Do individual doctor profile pages improve search engine rankings?
items.a: Yes. Detailed doctor profile pages with verified medical qualifications, specialties, and clinical achievements provide strong E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness) signals, helping your hospital rank for specialized surgical and consultation searches in Google.
